string-array.name: phq9_items
string-array.item: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Poor appetite or overeating
Feeling bad about yourself - or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite - being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

string-array.name: phq9_labels
string-array.item: Not at all
Several days
More than half the days
Nearly every day
Daily

string-array.name: gad7_items
string-array.item: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Trouble relaxing
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still
Becoming easily annoyed or irritable
Feeling afraid as if something awful might happen

string-array.name: pid5bf_items
string-array.item: People would describe me as reckless.
I feel like I act totally on impulse.
Even though it drives them crazy, I bully people into doing what I want.
I often have to deal with people who are less important than me.
I often make up things about myself to get what I want.
It is easy for me to take advantage of others.
I worry about almost everything.
I frequently get into physical fights.
I often feel like I have nothing to say to others.
I am always on the lookout for someone who is trying to scam me.
Use me or I use you is my motto.
I often feel like I am a drifting soul.
I often feel like I am not good enough.
I am usually pretty hostile.
I often feel empty inside.
I can be pretty mean to people.
I am often out of control.
I often feel like I am in a fog.
I often say things that others find odd or strange.
I enjoy taking risks.
I feel like I never get what I deserve.
I am often told that I am spaced out.
I often try to influence others.
I often get into trouble because I do not think before I act.
I often feel like I have no identity.

string-array.name: msibpd_items
string-array.item: Have your closest relationships been troubled by a lot of arguments or repeated breakups?
Have you deliberately hurt yourself physically (e.g., punched yourself, burned yourself, cut yourself, or tried to kill yourself)?
Do you have at least two other problems with impulsivity (e.g., eating binges and spending sprees, drinking too much and verbal outbursts)?
Have you been extremely moody?
Have you felt very angry a lot of the time? Or have you often acted in an angry or sarcastic manner?
Have you often been distrustful of other people?
Have you frequently felt unreal or as if things around you were unreal?
Have you chronically felt empty?
Have you often felt that you had no idea of who you are or that you have no identity?
Have you made desperate efforts to avoid being abandoned or left alone? (e.g., calling someone many times, begging them not to leave)

string-array.name: yes_no_options
string-array.item: No
Yes

string-array.name: pqb_items
string-array.item: Do familiar surroundings sometimes seem strange, confusing, threatening or unreal to you?
Have you heard unusual sounds like banging, clicking, hissing, clapping or ringing in your ears?
Do things that you see appear different from the way they usually do?
Have you had experiences with telepathy, psychic forces, or fortune telling?
Have you felt that you are not in control of your own ideas or thoughts?
Do you have strong feelings or beliefs about being unusually gifted or talented in some way?
Do you feel that other people are watching you or talking about you?
Do you sometimes feel strange things on or in your body?
Do you sometimes get strange feelings on or in your body?
Have you felt that you are not in control of your own ideas or thoughts?
Have you seen things that other people cannot see?
Do you hear voices that other people do not hear?
Do you get confused at times whether something you experienced was real or imaginary?
Do you hold beliefs that other people would find unusual or bizarre?
Do you feel that other people are paying attention to you or talking about you?
Do you feel that people are trying to harm you?
Do you feel that you have special powers?
Do you feel that your thoughts are being read by others?
Do you feel that messages are being sent to you through the TV or radio?
Do you feel that you are a special person?
Do you feel that you are being followed?
